Here is what the manuals say (verified quotes):
1. "For exhaust air temperature control:
Always mount upstream of the exhaust air fan." (siemens-duct-temperature-sensor-129-525, page 1)
2. "As a limit sensor for supply air temperature:
Mount as close as possible to the air outlet into the room." (siemens-duct-temperature-sensor-129-525, page 1)
3. "For dewpoint control:
Mount sensor immediately after the spray trap of the air washer." (siemens-duct-temperature-sensor-129-525, page 1)
4. "Manually bend the probe so that it lies diagonally across the duct or in equally spaced windings across the entire duct cross-section. The probe must not touch the duct wall (see Figure 2)." (siemens-duct-temperature-sensor-129-525, page 1)

citations_shown.quote:
For exhaust air temperature control:
Always mount upstream of the exhaust air fan.

As a limit sensor for supply air temperature:
Mount as close as possible to the air outlet into the room.

For dewpoint control:
Mount sensor immediately after the spray trap of the air washer.
Manually bend the probe so that it lies diagonally across the duct or in equally spaced windings across the entire duct cross-section. The probe must not touch the duct wall (see Figure 2).
